name: Reelock
seoTitle: Reelock: block Reels, Shorts and distracting apps on Android
summary: Removes addictive feeds, distracting apps and notification noise. Keeps the useful parts of your phone.
tagline: Keep the useful parts of your phone. Remove the addictive parts. Everything happens privately on your device.
pitch: Keep the useful parts of your phone. Remove the addictive parts. Reelock blocks Reels and Shorts, distracting apps, adult sites and notification noise, all on your device.
highlights: No account, no backend, works offline
Keeps messages and search, removes the feeds
Strict mode with humane emergency access

screenshots.alt: Reelock home screen: the time, a reflection and five apps
Protect: Shorts, TikTok feeds and Facebook Reels hidden
Web filter strength: Gentle, Balanced, Strict
Backup and privacy: records stay on the phone

features.title: One set of rules for every distraction
features.lead: Your home screen, apps, in-app feeds, websites and notifications, covered by one setting that is always on.

items.title: Remove the feed, keep the app
items.body: Keep messages and posting on Instagram, search and subscriptions on YouTube. Reels, Explore and Shorts close.

items.title: A calmer home screen
items.body: A task-first launcher organised around what you meant to do, not around app discovery.

items.title: Friction instead of walls
items.body: Show the time spent today, pause for a moment, or ask why the app is being opened. You choose the level.

items.title: Private adult protection
items.body: Local domain filtering, SafeSearch and YouTube Restricted Mode, working in every browser.

items.title: A notification firewall
items.body: Deliver, hold for a scheduled digest, or silence any app. Distracting badges go away.

items.title: Strict mode, humanely
items.body: A PIN or biometric lock, a cooldown before protection is weakened, and emergency access when you need it.

testing.teaser: The first 20 testers keep Reelock free for good: no ads, no subscription, and a gift box at 10,000 downloads.

perks.title: No ads, ever
perks.body: You never see an ad in Reelock. Not during the test, not after launch.

perks.title: No subscription
perks.body: If Reelock ever adds a premium plan, everything in it is yours without paying.

perks.title: Free forever
perks.body: The whole app stays free for you, for good. No trial, no catch.

perks.title: Shape the app
perks.body: Tell us what works and what gets in your way. Your view goes straight into what we fix and build next.

perks.title: Your name in the credits
perks.body: Testers are thanked by name as Reelock contributors, if you would like to be.

perks.title: A gift box at 10,000 downloads
perks.body: When Reelock passes 10,000 downloads, testers get a surprise gift box from us.

testing.finePrint: Spots go in the order people ask. Only the first 20 testers accepted into the closed test get these perks.
next: We add your Google account to the Reelock test on Google Play.
You get an email with the link to join.
Install Reelock from the Play Store as usual.
Tell us what works and what gets in your way, any time.

privacy.headline: Nothing you do in Reelock reaches us.
privacy.lead: Reelock has no account and no server. What it learns about how you use your phone stays on your phone. This version shows no advertising and contains no advertising or analytics SDK.
points: No backend server or cloud database
Browsing history, notification content and app usage are never sent to Reelock

stays.n: PIN kept only as a salted hash
Hourly and daily · 90 days or less
Encrypted · deleted at end of day
Only while Strict Mode is on

leaves.t: Website name lookups you have not blocked
leaves.n: Passed to the DNS resolver your network chose, the same lookup your phone makes anyway. Reelock records none of them.

leaves.t: An encrypted backup, if you make one
leaves.n: Written only where you choose, locked with your passphrase. Never contains your PIN.

map.reaches: We run no server and include no advertising, analytics or crash-reporting SDK. There is nothing for us to receive, so nothing for us to retrieve, correct or delete.

permissions.name: Accessibility
permissions.why: Detects Reels, Shorts and other feeds inside apps so Reelock can close only those parts.

permissions.name: VPN (local)
permissions.why: Filters websites on the device. Your traffic is checked on your phone and never sent to Reelock.

permissions.name: Notification access
permissions.why: Holds or silences notifications from the apps you choose and builds your digest.

studioProof.hard: An attention firewall built on an Accessibility service, a local VPN filter and a notification listener, with no server at all.
